name: Being Prepared
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of being vigilant and prepared for unforeseen challenges and the return of Christ. Proverbs encourages wise foresight and prudent action, as seen in the example of the ant and the prudent man who avoids harm by anticipating danger. The teachings of Jesus in Matthew highlight the necessity of readiness, urging believers to watch and be prepared at all times because the exact hour of the Son of Man's coming is unknown. The parable of the ten virgins further illustrates the call to maintain spiritual readiness to meet the bridegroom, symbolizing Christ's return.
